proposals.title: Rank the topic feed by traction, not only total views (owner note, 19 Nov)
proposals.change: In generator/topics.py score_parts, add a 'traction' part from demand.viewsPerDay and demand.ageDays (both now written by research on new topics): a reference under 30 days old adds up to +1.0 on a log scale of views per day (10K/day = +0.3, 100K/day = +0.7, 300K+/day = +1.0); a reference over 90 days old adds nothing. Topics without the fields score as today. Research keeps writing viewsPerDay/ageDays from the niche scan.

proposals.title: Our Shorts speak at 129-148 words a minute, not the 164 the pace fix aimed for
proposals.change: Check why the owner's pace fix (voice speed 0.92 -> 1.0, 'about 164 words a minute', commit 8cae8f7) lands at 140-148 words a minute in the three Shorts made since (timeline.json words over duration: transistor 148, Crossrail 140, mobile phone 148; microwave at 0.92 was 130). The gap is likely the beat pads and pauses between beats (channel.json beatPad, TEMPOS short 1.2). If the owner's note meant the spoken pace, close it (shorter pads, not a faster voice); if a pace change beyond that is wanted, it is a weekly-loop test on TEMPOS.
proposals.expectedEffect: The owner's addressed pace note actually delivered; 5 of 16 reference Shorts in our sheets are 'fast' narrators
proposals.risk: Cutting pads too far crowds the reveals; the pre-reveal drop (0.4 s) must stay

proposals.title: Long videos: show each operation happening, not its result appearing
proposals.change: In the director's prompt for long videos (and the 3D kit's beat helpers), each beat whose line says something does something gets a visible cause->effect chain in its moments: the input object enters, the machine part acts on it on the verb, the output leaves (e.g. in the ChatGPT video: a token card slides into the weight grid, rows light as it multiplies, a column of scores rises, the top one lifts out as the next word). Tiles, bars or cards that just appear are allowed only as a recap. Test it on the next long video behind a flag and compare its held-after-hook with L-20261127-21.
proposals.expectedEffect: Viewers who watch with the sound low can follow; fewer drops in the middle chapters of long videos
proposals.risk: More beat code per video; a wrong mechanism drawn is a factual error, so the fact reviewer must check the drawn steps
proposals.reason: The owner asked for it on both formats (note cmwz7z7mz), so it is a fix, not a test: director.md rule 13, lint and QA, 3D kit Operation3D/GearTrain (2026-11-28).
